result.stdout:
BTD6 Mod Helper Git hooks

Usage:
  btd6mh pre-commit
  btd6mh post-commit

pre-commit rotates and stages CHANGELOG.md when the staged
ModHelperData.Version increases.

post-commit creates an annotated local version tag. Existing
tags are never moved.
